Plucked!

A guide to a fair, simple, efficient and politically feasible tax and benefits system

Authors

Stephen Stretton

Gordon Styles

Published

Invalid Date

A book-length case for reforming UK taxes and benefits, written with Gordon Styles in 2020. Its fourteen chapters run from the ideas behind taxation and the principles of a good tax system to welfare and work, inequality, corporations, land and property, money and debt, and the environment, and end with a set of proposals. The manuscript is kept as written in 2020; only the title has changed.

Download: The whole book (docx)

Book manuscript, 2020, converted from R Markdown to Quarto in October 2026 without changes to the text. Retitled in October 2026; the 2020 title was ‘Screwed?! Getting our future back with tax and benefit reform’. Original chapter files are in Chapters-Rmd; the 2020 PDF is in 8.PreviousVersions.
